# ZebAlpha

> An Indian online e-commerce marketplace connecting customers with sellers and growing businesses across India, founded in Kolkata, West Bengal.

ZebAlpha is an Indian e-commerce marketplace connecting customers with sellers and growing businesses across India. Founded in Kolkata, West Bengal, by Rahul Adhikary and Alakesh Biswas, ZebAlpha is focused on making online shopping and online selling more accessible, transparent, and trustworthy.

## Disambiguation

ZebAlpha is an independent Indian e-commerce marketplace headquartered in Kolkata, West Bengal. It is not affiliated with Zone Alpha (a physical electronics shop in Navi Mumbai), Z Alpha, getzalpha, or any unrelated companies.

## Core Marketplace Principles

- Built for Small Businesses: 0% commission opportunities on eligible categories under actual seller policy.
- Customer Trust: Our goal is to make sure customers receive the product, variant, color, and size they actually ordered.
- Dedicated Seller Panel: Complete product catalog, real-time stock sync, and order dispatch tools.
- Transparent Pricing: Zero hidden marketplace fees with fair and predictable settlements.
- Compliant GST Guidelines: Supports eligible small businesses and sellers where permitted by applicable Indian laws and tax regulations.
